mustScenarios.risk: A 503 or network error is retried after 1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds; after the 5th failed attempt the event goes to the dead-letter table
A 400 or 404 response is not retried: the event goes straight to dead letters after one attempt
429 with Retry-After waits that many seconds before the next attempt, capped at 60 seconds
An endpoint that does not answer within 10 seconds counts as a failed attempt and is retried
Each attempt carries x-acme-signature t=<timestamp>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.body>, recomputed with a fresh timestamp
One endpoint failing does not stop or delay delivery to the other endpoints subscribed to the same event (deliveries run one after another today)
